summary: Gone tower listed at Keel, Dickenson County; no source found describes it. A separate Birch Knob tower in the same county is a different site.

notes_for_editor: Directory-only tower record: no source found gives a construction date, operator, design or removal date for Keel. The 1964 to 1978 details and the 1980 removal come from a county page about Birch Knob, a separate directory entry about 11 km north (my calculation from the two coordinate pairs); they do not apply to Keel and are used only to separate the two sites. The directory also lists a standing observation deck at the Birch Knob coordinates, which is not used. A search summary tied the Birch Knob tower to the name Keel; no source supports that link. Access is not recorded because no source describes the Keel site.
